content: .{@-पातः@} .²1 a look, glance; मार्गे मृगप्रोक्षिणि दृष्टिपातं कुरुष्व <ls>R. 13. 18</ls>; <ls>Bh. 1. 11</ls>, <ls n="Bh. 1.">94</ls>, <ls n="Bh.">3. 66</ls>. .²2 act of seeing, function of the eye; रजःकणैर्विध्नितदृष्टिपाताः <ls>Ku. 3. 31</ls> (<ls>Malli.</ls> interprets --unnecessarily in our opinion --पात by प्रभा).
